name: sparkles-text
title: Sparkles Text
description: Text with little four-point stars that twinkle in and out around it. The stars hold still under reduced motion.

props.name: text
props.description: The text. Screen readers read it as one string.

props.name: sparkles
props.description: Number of sparkles around the text.

props.name: colors
props.description: Colors the sparkles alternate between. Any CSS color.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds one sparkle takes to twinkle.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seed for where the sparkles sit.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Turns the animation off and renders plain text.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
